audit.title: Inference client step 9 closed-manifest reconciliation
audit.testPolicy: No suites were executed. The task prohibited state-mutating tests; classifications use current source, checked-in focused tests, structural scans, and live GitHub issue state.
audit.worktreeCaveat: The worktree was already heavily dirty and shared. No repository file was changed. The active design document itself was modified in the working tree, so this report describes the current working-tree text and current source, not a clean commit-only snapshot.

specSources.note: Read in full before the audit.

denominator.basis: Each independently observable behavior or acceptance obligation named by current section 5.3a, landing-order step 9, or the section 15c client cut-over/build log. Compound prose was split where one half can be delivered while another is tracked or missing.

structuralReceipts.truncation: No structural scan was truncated. Some exploratory terminal displays were output-truncated, but no classification relies on those displays; the final scans were machine-counted and the relevant source/test files were read directly.

explicitExclusions.reason: Not in the denominator. Section 8.3 lines 1847-1852 explicitly strikes the earlier step-9 obligation by owner ruling because prefetch is a latency optimization with automatic lazy fallback. The stale section 15c build-log sentence at line 2734 is superseded by that ruling; current client comments/tests also record the strike.

bottomLine: Step 9 is not completely delivered. Twenty-three behaviors have current implementation plus focused evidence, six undelivered behaviors are already covered by open issues #2528/#2549/#2568, and nine required behaviors/acceptance obligations form four genuinely untracked work items proposed above.
